name: @penumbra-labs/registry
description: Community release branch of the Penumbra chain/asset registry, published from github.com/penumbrafi/registry. Root-level shim that lets pnpm/npm/bun consume this repository via `github:penumbrafi/registry#rotko-release` without a nested `npm/` subpath install. The package keeps the name `@penumbra-labs/registry` so existing imports and `@penumbra-zone/*` peer ranges resolve unchanged; the real sources live in `./npm`, whose prebuilt `dist/` is committed here so a git install needs no build step.
